preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()[0:2])
preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly two integers n and m (3 ≤ n ≤ 150000, 0 ≤ m ≤ n*(n-1)/2).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines contains exactly two distinct integers ai and bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n, ai ≠ bi).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n and int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: All member numbers are within the valid range and distinct in each pair.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if all(not (int(x) == int(y) and int(y) == int(z) and int(x) != int(z)) or (int(x), int(z)) in friend_pairs or (int(z), int(x)) in friend_pairs for x, y, z in combinations) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if for every three distinct members (X, Y, Z), if X-Y and Y-Z are friends, then X-Z must also be friends. Here, friend_pairs is the set of all unordered friend pairs from the input, and combinations are all possible triplets of distinct members.
